title: Common definitions
description: Shared definitions for all powerstation.ai data files.

SchemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Version of the data contract. Bump it on every schema change.

DataState.title: DataState
DataState.description: measured = reported by a grid operator or the named source. planned = day-ahead schedule or forecast. modelled = inferred by powerstation.ai (needs a method). missing = no value (the value is null).

UtcTimestamp.title: UtcTimestamp
UtcTimestamp.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with a Z suffix, e.g. 2026-11-25T12:00:00Z.

Resolution.title: Resolution
Resolution.description: ISO 8601 duration of one step. v1 publishes hourly data only: the pipeline aggregates 15- and 30-minute source data to hourly averages.

ZoneId.title: ZoneId
ZoneId.description: Bidding zone id, e.g. DE-LU, FR, IT-North, NO1. Defined in v1/meta/zones.json.

CountryCode.title: CountryCode
CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

Window.title: Window
Window.description: Time range the file covers. start is inclusive, end is exclusive.

TimeSeries.title: TimeSeries
TimeSeries.description: Columnar time series. Value i covers [start + i*resolution, start + (i+1)*resolution). values and states have the same length. A null value has state missing, and a missing state has a null value.

unit.description: MW = average power over the step.

method.description: How modelled values were made, in plain English. Required when any state is modelled.

Envelope.title: Envelope
Envelope.description: Fields that every data file has.

dataset.description: Kind of file. Selects the schema.

mock.description: true for fixtures and demo data. The deploy step refuses files with mock: true.

source.description: Name of the data source, e.g. ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.

license.description: License of the data, e.g. CC-BY-4.0 or ODbL-1.0.
